source.content: public class CacheBuilderEvidenceLoader implements Cache.CacheBuilder { public Object doLoad(String key) { return 'loaded:' + key; } }

@isTest private class CoreRuntimeCacheBuilderEvidenceTest { @isTest static void rows() { Cache.OrgPartition orgPart = Cache.Org.getPartition('builder'); Cache.SessionPartition sessionPart = Cache.Session.getPartition('builder'); Cache.Partition generalOrg = orgPart; Cache.Partition generalSession = sessionPart; Cache.OrgPartition.validateCacheBuilder(CacheBuilderEvidenceLoader.class); Cache.SessionPartition.validateCacheBuilder(CacheBuilderEvidenceLoader.class); generalOrg.put('ttl', 'org ttl', 60); generalOrg.put('visible', 'org visible', 60, Cache.Visibility.ALL, false); generalSession.put('sessionTtl', 'session ttl', 60); generalSession.put('sessionVisible', 'session visible', 60, Cache.Visibility.NAMESPACE, false); System.assertEquals('org ttl', (String) generalOrg.get('ttl')); System.assertEquals('org visible', (String) generalOrg.get('visible')); System.assertEquals('session ttl', (String) generalSession.get('sessionTtl')); System.assertEquals('session visible', (String) generalSession.get('sessionVisible')); System.assertEquals('loaded:miss', (String) orgPart.get(CacheBuilderEvidenceLoader.class, 'miss')); System.assertEquals('loaded:miss', (String) orgPart.get(CacheBuilderEvidenceLoader.class, 'miss')); } }
